SELECT "xt"."datepart_utf8__m" "p", "xt"."measure_xt_total" "v" 
FROM (
  SELECT
        EXTRACT(month FROM ("xt".ts::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')) "datepart_utf8__m", sum("xt".amt) "measure_xt_total"
      FROM
        audit.xt AS "xt"  GROUP BY 1
) AS "xt"
ORDER BY "xt"."datepart_utf8__m" ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 50000

  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY EXTRACT(dow FROM "q"."d") ASC NULLS LAST
) AS "q"
LIMIT 50000
